market_question: Will the US acquire part of Greenland in 2026?
reasoning: The US acquiring part of Greenland by end-2026 requires either a voluntary transfer (purchase/lease) or forcible seizure. Denmark and Greenland's leadership have repeatedly and categorically rejected any sovereignty transfer. No negotiations are underway, and the 2024 US election does not change the implausibility of a binding agreement within two years. Use of force is not a realistic scenario. Thus true odds are far below the 13.5% market price.
evidence_points: Danish PM Mette Frederiksen called 2019 purchase talk 'absurd' and that stance is unchanged.
Greenlandic government statements consistently oppose ceding territory to foreign powers.
No US administration has proposed a serious acquisition plan or dedicated diplomatic resources to it.
Military coercion by the US against a NATO ally is near zero probability.
sources_consulted: Reuters (2019, 2023 coverage of Greenland purchase talks)
